agency.name: Division of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services, Alabama Department of Mental Health

narrNote: AARR is confirmed on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, checked 2026-10-22), which describes it as the accredited NARR affiliate for the state of Alabama.
notes: Agency is SAMHSA's Single State Agency for Alabama (Alabama Department of Mental Health); its division page now titles the unit 'Division of Mental Health & Substance Use Services.' Agency phone 1-800-367-0955 is ADMH's published line, also printed on the official Alabama Medicaid MH/SUD fact sheet for locating providers. R.O.S.S. is Alabama's peer-run recovery organization (6 recovery community centers; outreach in 35 counties) and operates the statewide 24/7 peer substance-use helpline at 844-307-1760, the same number ADMH publishes as its substance use line. ADMH Provider Directory covers 200+ certified community providers at 600+ locations, searchable/filterable by county (all 67 counties). Medicaid SUD services are delivered through ADMH-contracted providers per the Alabama Medicaid Agency fact sheet linked here.
